== Biography ==
Susanna Pannell Glasgow is named as the daughter of  the late James Glasgow in an 1837 court notice in the Baltimore Gazette & Daily Advertiser.<ref>Baltimore Gazette & Daily Advertiser, Friday, 23 June 1837,  Volume 87, Issue 14465, Page 4, Column 5. Image found on {{FindAGrave|105585399|sameas="no"}}</ref>

Susanna married Thomas Archer on 16 November 1841 in Harford County, Maryland.<ref>"Maryland Marriages, 1666-1970", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:F4J2-39K : 16 January 2020), Susannah P. Glasgow in entry for Thomas Archer, 1841.</ref>
